**Finding: Deviation (high severity) — EXCLUSIVITY**

Section 2.2 (p0013) makes Copperleaf our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — an unqualified, full-term exclusive dealing obligation binding us, with no category limit, no 12-month cap, and no performance-based exit. That sits at the playbook's walk-away position.

Aggravating context:
- **Section 12.3 (p0049)** has Vendor acknowledge that "Customer has made no exclusivity … or minimum-volume … commitment" — a direct internal contradiction, and the order-of-precedence clause (duplicate-numbered 2.2, p0014) does not resolve it.
- **Section 2.1 (p0012)** layers a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment on top, so exclusivity would leave us with no sourcing flexibility at all.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** Section 2.2 becomes "Vendor will be a non-exclusive provider of hosted analytics services, and Customer may procure the same or similar services from any third party at any time." The comment offers the fallback (single defined category, 12 months, automatic termination on SLA or delivery failure) if Copperleaf pushes back.
